Cuban Says Independents Could Hurt Democrats
Cuban disagreed with the proposals, writing, "I’m against all of these."
He argued that independent voters were becoming increasingly influential because they weren’t tied to either party.
"The fact [that] independents are NOT an organized party, means we can individually do what we think is right, without regard to party politics," Cuban wrote.
He also pointed to growing frustration with traditional party politics, warning that "pushing these would backfire on Democrats."
